_readme: Packages. featured: true + position (1-3) puts a package on the home page. active: false hides it everywhere. price_inr: null shows 'Price on request'. note: optional line under the itinerary. image: a path under assets/img/ replaces the illustrated placeholder. styles: luxury | adventure | honeymoon | family | snow. activities: kayak | cruise | trail | cycling | motorbike | paragliding | balloon | bus | car.

packages.title: Almaty: snow games
packages.places: Almaty · Shymbulak · Big Almaty Lake · Charyn Canyon
packages.summary: Spring snow in the Tien Shan: ski and snowboard lessons at Shymbulak, snow tubing and a horse sleigh, then a frozen alpine lake and a canyon day, a short flight from Delhi or Dubai.
packages.departure: Small-group departure · late Mar / early Apr 2027
packages.price_basis: per person, twin share, flights from India or the UAE incl.
itinerary: Your guide meets you at arrivals. An easy evening up Kok-Tobe by cable car for the city lights against the mountains.
Gondola from Medeu up to Shymbulak. Beginners start with a private ski or snowboard instructor; non-skiers try snow tubing and a horse sleigh.
Upper lifts to Talgar Pass at about 3,200 m, weather permitting, for views of Talgar Peak. Afternoon free on the slopes or in the spa.
A 4×4 drive to the lake, often still frozen at the end of March. Snow play and a hot lunch in the mountains.
A full day in the 'little Grand Canyon' of Kazakhstan: an easy walk through the Valley of Castles with your guide.
Zenkov Cathedral, Panfilov Park and the Green Bazaar, then a farewell Kazakh dinner.
includes: Return flights from India or the UAE
Shymbulak lift passes and a beginners' ski or snowboard lesson
Ski or snowboard equipment and clothing rental
Private transport and 4×4 for the lake
Daily breakfast and 4 dinners, vegetarian options
excludes: Visa: not needed for Indian passports for stays up to 14 days (other nationalities: we check with you)
packages.note: Late season: Shymbulak's ski season runs into April. We set final dates with the resort's snow report, and plan snow time for the mornings when it is firmest.

packages.title: New Zealand adventure
packages.places: Auckland · Rotorua · Tongariro · Queenstown · Milford Sound
packages.summary: Autumn in New Zealand: glowworm caves, a volcanic alpine crossing, jet boats and bungy in Queenstown, and a cruise through Milford Sound. Golden Arrowtown to finish.
packages.price_basis: per person, twin share, flights from India or the UAE incl.
itinerary: Met at arrivals. Sky Tower at sunset and a harbour walk.
Boat ride through the Waitomo glowworm caves, then on to Rotorua and an evening Māori cultural experience with a hāngī dinner.
Geothermal valleys in the morning; mountain biking in the Redwoods or the Skyline luge in the afternoon.
New Zealand's best day hike across volcanic craters and emerald lakes, weather permitting, with a shorter walk for anyone who prefers it.
Domestic flight south. Skyline gondola and luge above Lake Wakatipu.
Shotover River jet boat for everyone; the Kawarau Bridge bungy for the brave.
Scenic drive into Fiordland and a cruise beneath the waterfalls, with an optional sea-kayak.
Choose a tandem skydive, canyon swing or a gentle lakeside cycle to Frankton.
The old gold-mining town at its April best, with its trees turning gold. Farewell dinner.
includes: Waitomo, Māori cultural evening, jet boat and Milford Sound cruise
Daily breakfast and 5 dinners, vegetarian options
excludes: New Zealand visitor visa (we prepare the file with you)
packages.note: Tongariro and Milford Sound depend on the weather; we keep a spare half-day and an alternative for each.

packages.title: Uzbekistan & Kyrgyzstan: Silk Road to the mountains
packages.places: Tashkent · Samarkand · Bukhara · Bishkek · Issyk-Kul · Karakol
packages.summary: The blue domes of Samarkand and Bukhara by high-speed train, then across to Kyrgyzstan for alpine valleys, a lake the size of a sea and a yurt lunch. May is the season for both.
packages.price_basis: per person, twin share, flights from India or the UAE incl.
itinerary: Met at arrivals. Chorsu Bazaar and the Khast Imam complex.
Afrosiyob train in about two hours. The Registan at golden hour.
Shah-i-Zinda, Gur-e-Amir and Bibi-Khanym, with a paper-making workshop in Konigil.
Train to Bukhara. Evening at Lyabi-Hauz under the mulberry trees.
The Ark fortress, Kalyan Minaret and the old trading domes, with a folk show at dinner.
Fast train to Tashkent; the metro's palace-like stations and a free evening.
Short flight to Kyrgyzstan. Ala-Too Square and Osh Bazaar.
A guided valley walk under snow peaks, paced for every age.
Drive to the lake. Cholpon-Ata's open-air petroglyphs and a lakeside evening.
The red 'Seven Bulls' rocks, a yurt lunch with a nomad family and an eagle-hunting demonstration.
Drive back to Bishkek for your flight.
includes: Return international flights and the Tashkent–Bishkek flight
Daily breakfast and 6 dinners, vegetarian options
excludes: Uzbekistan and Kyrgyzstan e-visas (we apply with you)
packages.note: May has mild days in the Silk Road cities and green valleys in Kyrgyzstan. High-pasture yurt camps such as Song-Kul usually open from June, so this route stays lower.

packages.title: Darjeeling & Gangtok: Sandakphu trek
packages.places: Darjeeling · Singalila National Park · Sandakphu · Gangtok · Tsomgo Lake
packages.summary: Tea gardens and the toy train, then a guided trek along the Singalila Ridge to Sandakphu, the highest point in West Bengal, for sunrise over Kangchenjunga and, on a clear day, Everest. Gangtok and a high lake to finish.
packages.price_basis: per person, twin share, flights from your city quoted on request
itinerary: Met at Bagdogra airport. A scenic drive up through the tea gardens to Darjeeling.
Tiger Hill at sunrise, Batasia Loop, a joyride on the UNESCO-listed toy train and a tea-estate tasting. Kit check with your trek leader.
Drive to the trailhead and begin the Singalila Ridge trek with licensed local guides. A short first day to settle in.
Forest and ridge walking along the India–Nepal border, through rhododendron in spring.
The final climb to Sandakphu at about 3,636 m. Sunset over the Kangchenjunga range.
Dawn views of the Sleeping Buddha — Kangchenjunga — and, on a clear morning, Everest, Lhotse and Makalu. Descend towards Srikhola.
Walk out to Rimbik and drive back to Darjeeling for a hot shower and a celebration dinner.
Along the Teesta valley into Sikkim. An evening on MG Marg.
A permit day trip to the glacial lake at about 3,750 m and Baba Mandir, weather and road permitting.
Rumtek Monastery, the ropeway and a free afternoon.
Drive to Bagdogra for your flight.
includes: Hotels in Darjeeling and Gangtok, trek lodges on the ridge
Licensed local trek guides and porters for the Singalila section
Singalila National Park and Tsomgo Lake permits
All meals on the trek; breakfast and dinner in towns
A viotours trek leader with a first-aid and oxygen kit
excludes: Flights to Bagdogra (quoted from your city)
Restricted Area Permit for foreign nationals (we arrange it)
packages.note: Adventure level High: four trekking days at altitude on rough trails, up to about 3,636 m. Travellers should be comfortable walking 6–7 hours a day. We send a fitness plan and check every traveller before booking. Ridge lodges are simple and shared.

packages.title: Shillong & Guwahati: Dawki kayaking
packages.places: Guwahati · Shillong · Sohra (Cherrapunji) · Nongriat · Dawki · Mawlynnong
packages.summary: Living root bridges, waterfalls in the clouds and a kayak on the glass-clear Umngot river at Dawki. Meghalaya's best, with a sunset cruise on the Brahmaputra to begin.
packages.price_basis: per person, twin share, flights from your city quoted on request
itinerary: Met at the airport. Kamakhya Temple and a sunset cruise on the Brahmaputra.
Past Umiam Lake into the hills. An evening at Police Bazaar.
Nohkalikai Falls, the Seven Sisters Falls and the Mawsmai caves.
A guided trek down to Nongriat's double-decker living root bridge and the blue pools beyond. Plenty of steps, at an easy pace.
The famously clean village of Mawlynnong and the Riwai root bridge, then on to the Umngot river.
A morning kayak on water so clear the boats seem to float, with snorkelling and cliff jumps for the bold. Riverside camp or guesthouse.
Laitlum canyons at sunrise, Ward's Lake and a Khasi dinner.
includes: 7 nights in hotels, a homestay and a riverside camp
Kayaking with a licensed operator, life jackets and a safety boat
Root-bridge trek with a local Khasi guide
Daily breakfast and 5 dinners, vegetarian options
excludes: Flights to Guwahati (quoted from your city)
packages.note: Adventure level Medium: one demanding day of steps at Nongriat (we pace it, and anyone can stay back in Sohra) and kayaking suitable for beginners. The Umngot is clearest from about November to April; in the monsoon it turns muddy and boating can be suspended, so we don't run this trip then.

packages.title: Swiss Alps by snow train
packages.summary: Glacier Express, a morning on Jungfraujoch and a quiet chalet week in Zermatt, paced for grandparents and children alike.
packages.price_basis: per person, twin share, flights from Chennai or Dubai incl.
itinerary: Your guide meets you at arrivals. Private coach to the lakeside hotel in Lucerne; an easy evening walk across the Chapel Bridge.
Cogwheel railway up, cable car down. Time is built in for rest stops and warm drinks at the summit.
The rail journey to the Top of Europe. Our guide carries altitude kits and plans the day around the slowest walker.
First-class panoramic carriages to Zermatt, with lunch served at your seat.
Gornergrat views of the Matterhorn, a beginners' snow-play session for children, and a free day to simply be together.
Rail to Zurich airport with assisted check-in.
includes: 8 nights in 4-star hotels and a family chalet
Daily breakfast and 5 dinners, vegetarian and Jain options
A viotours guide from arrival to departure
excludes: Schengen visa fees (we prepare the file with you)

packages.title: Bali for three generations
packages.summary: A private villa with a pool, temple mornings with a local storyteller, and an easy pace the elders will thank you for.
packages.price_basis: per person, twin share, flights incl.
itinerary: Met at the gate, wheelchair assistance on request. Private van to your villa in Ubud.
Tirta Empul and Tegallalang in the cool of the morning, back for lunch and a rest.
A gentle downhill ride through villages for the active ones; a Balinese cooking class for everyone else.
A beachfront resort, sunset at Tanah Lot and a day cruise to Nusa Penida.
Spa, shopping or the pool. Your guide stays on call.
includes: Private pool villa and beach resort
All transfers in a private air-conditioned van

packages.title: Cappadocia by balloon
packages.summary: A sunrise balloon flight, cave-hotel nights and the Bosphorus by private yacht. For groups who want a little thrill with their comfort.
packages.price_basis: per person, twin share, flights incl.
itinerary: Hagia Sophia, the Blue Mosque and the Grand Bazaar, then a private yacht on the Bosphorus at dusk.
Check in to a cave hotel. An evening walk through Love Valley with your guide.
Licensed operators only, with a weather day kept in reserve. Afternoon at the Göreme open-air museum.
Valleys on foot or by ATV
Choose a guided trail through Rose Valley or an ATV ride. Both end at a family-run pottery.
The white travertine terraces and the ancient pools of Hierapolis.
includes: 7 nights including 2 in a cave hotel
Balloon flight with a licensed operator

packages.title: Maldives, just the two of you
packages.summary: An overwater villa, a private sandbank dinner and a seaplane arrival. We handle every detail so the week is yours.
itinerary: Met at Malé airport, then a 30-minute seaplane flight to your overwater villa.
Snorkelling with a marine guide and a kayak around the house reef.
A private dinner on a sandbank, with a sunset dolphin cruise on the way.
Couples' spa, a floating breakfast and nothing on the schedule.
Seaplane back to Malé for your flight.
includes: Half board with one private dinner
Honeymoon set-up and a couples' spa
excludes: Green tax payable at the resort

packages.title: Japan in cherry season
packages.summary: Bullet trains, a ryokan night with an onsen and Kyoto's temples in bloom, with a guide who knows where the crowds aren't.
packages.price_basis: per person, twin share, flights incl.
itinerary: Asakusa, Shibuya and a day trip to the Fuji Five Lakes, with Indian vegetarian dinners arranged ahead.
A ryokan night with a private onsen and a kaiseki dinner.
Philosopher's Path, Fushimi Inari at dawn, a tea ceremony and Arashiyama's bamboo grove.
The deer park at Nara, then Osaka's food streets and a free afternoon.
Shinkansen luggage forwarding and assisted check-in.
includes: Japan Rail Pass and seat reservations

packages.title: A family gathering in the UAE
packages.places: Dubai · Abu Dhabi · Ras Al Khaimah
packages.summary: Bring the whole family together for a wedding, anniversary or reunion. Desert camp dinner, a dhow cruise and Jebel Jais for the brave.
packages.price_basis: per person, twin share, flights incl.
itinerary: Group meet-and-greet, private coach and a welcome dinner together.
Al Fahidi, the souks by abra, and the Burj Khalifa at sunset. A dhow cruise dinner.
4×4 dune drive, camel rides for the children and a long dinner under the stars.
Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque and the Louvre Abu Dhabi.
Jebel Jais viewpoint; the zipline for those who want it, tea on the deck for those who don't.
includes: Private coach for the whole group
Desert safari and dhow cruise dinner
excludes: Event venue for your function (we can arrange)

packages.title: Ladakh high passes
packages.summary: Royal Enfield or SUV over Khardung La, a night at Pangong and the monasteries of the Indus, with oxygen and a doctor on call.
packages.price_basis: per person, twin share, flights from Chennai incl.
itinerary: Two slow days in Leh. Shanti Stupa at sunset and our doctor's check before going higher.
Over Khardung La by bike or SUV. Sand dunes and Diskit monastery.
Along the Shyok river to the lake. A heated luxury camp on the shore.
Hemis and Thiksey, and a rafting stretch on the Indus for those who want it.
includes: 7 nights in hotels and a heated camp
Royal Enfield or SUV with driver
Back-up vehicle, oxygen and a doctor on call
